tips:
## Text Message Abbreviations and Digital Communication

### Common Texting Abbreviations

Hebrew texters love abbreviations! Here are some common ones:

| Abbreviation | Full Form | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| בנ"א | בני אדם | people |
| אחלה | — | great, awesome |
| סבבה | — | cool, OK |
| בלי נדר | — | no promises (literally "without a vow") |
| תודה רבה | תודה | thanks a lot |

### Digital Communication Verbs

| Verb | Meaning | Past (אני) |
|---|---|---|
| לשלוח | to send | שלחתי |
| לקבל | to receive | קיבלתי |
| למחוק | to delete | מחקתי |
| להעביר | to forward | העברתי |
| לענות | to reply | עניתי |

### Negative Commands

To say "don't" with a future-tense verb, use **אל** + future:
- **אל תמחק** — don't delete
- **אל תעביר** — don't forward
- **אל תשלח** — don't send

This is the correct way to give a negative command in Hebrew (not using לא).

### Texting Culture

Israelis tend to use WhatsApp groups (**קבוצות ווטסאפ**) for everything — work, family, friends, and building committees!
